params.body:
The layers graph labels each layer with its name and how many nodes it holds. On a trend page the top layer is always the one trend, so it read "The trend 1", a number that says nothing.

A layer with a single node now shows its name only, both in the labels beside the graph and in the legend under it on a narrow screen. Layers with more than one keep their count, so the home showcase, with many trends, is unchanged.

`resources/js/insight-graph.js` only; no PHP changes, no test touches the graph's labels.
params.title: Graph: no count on a layer of one
